title: GovernanceEventEffector
description: Effector archetype for governance event emission. Typed by eventType (governance verb) and subjectRef (governance target). A governance event effector emits signals into the governance fabric — evaluation triggers, compliance assertions, or sourcing notifications. Source: ITIP Meta-Governance Ontology; GSM Effector semantics.

eventType.description: Governance event discriminator. Identity-bound: effectors of the same Definition always emit the same event type. Source: ITIP meta-governance.

subjectRef.description: URI reference to the governance subject this effector targets. Identity-bound: effectors of the same Definition always target the same governance subject. Source: GSM Ascription lifecycle.
